message.content: The retry loop in sync/client.py swallows the timeout error instead of retrying. Find out why and fix it.

content.thinking: Two except clauses in one loop is the usual shape of this bug. Read the function before guessing which branch is wrong.

content.text: Found it. The `except ConnectionError` branch returns None on the first hit instead of retrying, and it sits close enough to the timeout branch to look like it belongs to it. TimeoutError itself does retry correctly — it is ConnectionError silently eating the loop.
Both exceptions now retry the same way and only raise on the last attempt. Ran tests/test_client.py: 6 passed.

aiTitle: fix retry loop swallowing timeout errors
